summary: Vidalta’s first-property configuration should center on maintenance execution: mobile work, workload-based auto-assignment, skills and property coverage, distinct standard-turn and renovation workflows, integrated inspections, and clear emergency priority. Several exact policy choices remain open because these were sales calls, not configuration workshops. Job costing, purchasing, analytics, accounting validation, training, and vendor compliance are product/workflow requirements rather than catalog settings.

settings.meaning: Classifies maintenance users correctly and enables department-related assignment functionality.
settings.assumption: Technicians and supervisors will use Entrata directly rather than sharing accounts.
reasoning: Vidalta wants every technician using the mobile application and wants work routed to specific technicians.
The Maintenance department is therefore the appropriate starting classification, but individual user setup was not explicitly approved.

callsUsed.title: Entrata (Chris) and Hector (Vidalta) sync
callsUsed.brief: Alex and Chris from Entrata, along with Hector from Vidalta Property Management, discussed Hector's dissatisfaction with RealPage's AI capabilities, data accessibility, and lack of essential features, which forces his team to build custom solutions for maintenance, Capex tracking, and rent analysis. Hector expressed interest in Entrata's one-data architecture, AI advancements, and specific features related to Capex management, job costing, and maintenance during an upcoming demo. The Entrata team plans to prioritize demonstrating their facilities app, job costing, and cataloging features, while also addressing Hector's need for better data accessibility and BI tools.

callsUsed.title: Entrata Demo: Maintenance, AI, Centralization, Job Costing: Vidalta
callsUsed.brief: Alex and Chris from Entrata, along with Hector from Vidalta Property Management, discussed Entrata's advanced maintenance, job costing, and BI solutions, highlighting their integrated platform and AI capabilities as a superior alternative to RealPage. Hector expressed interest in Entrata's offerings, particularly for upcoming property acquisitions, and outlined a strategy to potentially transition a portion of Vidalta's portfolio to Entrata within the next year. The conversation also touched upon Entrata's training resources and its ability to address past financial reconciliation issues that had previously deterred Vidalta from switching.
